milestones.claim: Define a machine-readable milestone status report model over existing story facts.
milestones.doneMeans: Report schema exposes story id, phase, milestone rows, grouped status, sub-objectives, evidence refs, risks, and next actions without creating new storage.

milestones.claim: Expose a read-only lattice milestone_status CLI command.
milestones.doneMeans: Command supports text and JSON output, rejects mutation-like flags, and prints completed/current/remaining groups.

milestones.claim: Project checklist completion and verification detail into milestone rows.
milestones.doneMeans: Rows derive status and next actions from milestone ledger, checklist refs, verificationIntent, verificationEvidence, and summary facts where available.

milestones.claim: Document and test the grouped progress reporting workflow.
milestones.doneMeans: Tests cover JSON/text/missing-ledger behavior and docs explain host reporting contract without claiming automatic execution or production readiness.
